attach-evidence.description: Adds proof to an entry recorded without it. The entry itself is not edited.

record-reading.description: A standalone reading. A value lower than the last is kept with a warning, never refused.

add-note.description: A short remark on the vehicle's history. Notes are never edited.

report-issue.description: Something is wrong with the vehicle. Safety-critical grounds it at once.

create-work-order.description: Plan the repair and its expected cost, from a reported problem or as preventive work.

approve-work-order.description: Finance authorizes the spending before work starts. Whoever created it cannot authorize it.

complete-work-order.description: Say what was done and what it cost.

approve-completion.description: Checks the completed work and its actual cost. Whoever completed it cannot sign it off.

cancel-work-order.description: Stop a work order that is no longer needed. A reason is required.

release.description: Ends the grounding once the repair is completed. After a safety-critical problem, whoever vouched for the repair cannot release.

start-trip.description: Opens the sheet with this vehicle as the main vehicle.

change-custodian.description: Who answers for the vehicle day to day. Not the same as who drives each activity.

transfer-branch.description: Moves the vehicle's home branch for good. Past records stay with the branch that made them.

add-document.description: Insurance, inspection, permits. A missing expiry date shows as unknown, never as valid.

renew-document.description: Records the new version of a document. The old one is kept.

record-revenue.description: Freight or fares earned with this vehicle.

review-entry.label: Review entry
review-entry.description: Approve or reject an entry waiting for review. Whoever recorded it cannot approve it.

reverse-entry.description: Posted money is never edited: a reversal cancels it and both stay. Pick the entry in Money.

commission.description: From registered to in service: the operating history starts here.

all.title: All actions
all.description: Everything you can do on {vehicle}, by area.
all.searchPlaceholder: Search, e.g. fuel, renew, sign off
